name: Charnel Winds
body:
School necromancy [air]; Level death mage 6, magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (handful of grave dirt into the air)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (20-ft. radius, 60 ft. high)
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A blast of wind bearing the vile smell of death blasts downward, inflicting 4d6 negative energy damage +1 point per caster level to all creatures in the area and knocking them prone. A successful Fortitude save halves the negative energy damage and negates being knocked prone. Flying creatures forced into the ground by the powerful downdraft take damage as if they fell unless they make a DC 15 Fly check, in which case they remain at their original altitude.

Any creature that takes damage from a charnel wind becomes nauseated for 1 round, then sickened for 1 minute thereafter. Undead creatures in the area are healed by the amount of negative energy damage.
